paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how BLEU varies with the length of a gold prefix under a prefix-constrained decoding setting, showing two model curves labeled in the legend as “Consistency-CE” and “Consistency-Bi.” The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 20 with major tick labels at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 23 to 29 with evenly spaced tick marks at 1-unit intervals. The “Consistency-CE” series is drawn as a blue dashed line with open circle markers; it starts near 24.6 at prefix length 0, dips to about 23.7 at 1, then rises overall through the range, reaching about 25.1 at 5, about 26.2 at 12, about 27.0 at 16, and ending around 28.1 at 20. The “Consistency-Bi” series is drawn as an orange solid line with filled square markers; it begins around 27.6 at 0, reaches approximately 28.1 at 5, then decreases across larger prefix lengths, passing through about 27.0 at 8, about 26.0 at 12, about 25.1 at 14, about 24.4 at 16, and ending near 24.0 at 20.
